lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 오늘은 예절에 대해 이야기해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, shall we talk about etiquette today?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, oneureun yejeore daehae iyagihae bollaeyo?
lines.en: Yes, sunbae. I've been curious about Korean etiquette.

lines.beaver_en: How do you talk to people you're close to?
lines.en: Close friends use a lot of informal speech, right?

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 그런데 친하면 언제나 반말해도 돼요?
lines.beaver_en: Right. But if you're close, can you always speak informally?
lines.beaver_roman: Majayo. Geureonde chinhamyeon eonjena banmalhaedo dwaeyo?
lines.learner: 친하다고 해서 다 반말을 하는 것은 아니에요.
lines.en: Being close doesn't mean everyone uses informal speech.
lines.roman: Chinhadago haeseo da banmareul haneun geoseun anieyo.

lines.beaver_en: You know it well. Then what about elders?
lines.en: With elders, I use polite speech and call them by their title.

lines.beaver_en: You also shake hands when you first meet, right?
lines.learner: 네, 웃어른과는 두 손으로 악수하면 되죠?
lines.en: Yes, I should shake hands with elders using both hands, right?
lines.roman: Ne, udeoreungwaneun du soneuro aksuhamyeon doejyo?

lines.beaver_en: Good. Is it okay to speak informally to juniors?
lines.learner: 아랫사람이라고 해서 다 반말하는 건 아니죠.
lines.en: Not everyone speaks informally just because someone is junior.
lines.roman: Araetsaramirago haeseo da banmalhaneun geon anijyo.

lines.beaver_en: Right. Then how do you greet guests?
lines.en: I welcome guests at the door with a smile.
I go outside the door to see them off.

lines.beaver: 아주 잘하네요. 다음 주에 교수님 댁에 가지요?
lines.beaver_en: Very good. You're visiting your professor's home next week, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Aju jalhaneyo. Daeum jue gyosunim daege gajiyo?
lines.learner: 네, 교수님을 뵈러 가요. 조금 떨려요.
lines.en: Yes, I'm going to see my professor. I'm a bit nervous.
lines.roman: Ne, gyosunimeul boereo gayo. Jogeum tteollyeoyo.

lines.beaver: 오늘 배운 예절만 기억하면 괜찮을 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: Just remember the etiquette you learned today and you'll be fine.
lines.beaver_roman: Oneul baeun yejeolman gieokamyeon gwaenchaneul geoyeyo.
lines.en: Thank you, sunbae. See you next time.
